name: British Indian Ocean Territory
facts: Claimed by Mauritius; a treaty signed in 2025 to transfer the islands had not been ratified as of 2026

flag.description: The Union Jack in the canton on a field of wavy dark blue and white horizontal lines, with a green palm tree rising behind a gold crown in the fly.
flag.symbolism: The wavy lines are the Indian Ocean around the islands, the palm tree stands for the islands themselves, and the crown for British sovereignty.

hook: The British Indian Ocean Territory is the Union Jack floating on rolling waves, with a palm tree sprouting out of a crown.
trivia: The flag was granted in 1990 to mark the territory's 25th anniversary.
The islands have had no permanent civilian population since the Chagossians were removed in the late 1960s and early 1970s to make way for the military base on Diego Garcia.
